method: Manual comparison of normalized name candidates, exact branch/building/street tags and official reference descriptions. A matched_site means a plausible named public site/branch, not independently measured coordinate accuracy, current opening, product availability or a verified entrance. Other branches of the same chain, ATMs versus banks, streets/stops versus squares, and monuments versus their surrounding plazas are not interchangeable matches. Frozen expected-floor mistakes are retained and corrected explicitly below.
disposition: Proceed with the bounded Pasig/Ortigas rectangular map/road feasibility pilot. OSM remains the candidate regional basemap source and a partial catalog source, not a complete automatic errand-destination catalog. Later M3-06/M3-07/M5-04 must retain missing/ambiguous/no-candidate outcomes, inspect branch identity/category conflicts, and permit explicit manual pins. Do not claim automatic support for the sampled Galleria public-service counters or salons from this extract. Do not claim all stores are open or exact entrances are verified.
limitations: The rectangle includes adjacent-city portions of Ortigas (Quezon City and Mandaluyong) and neighboring areas; it is not the Pasig administrative polygon or a citywide support claim.

The sample was selected independently of OSM, but deliberately clusters mall errands, one bank brand and Pasig Poblacion landmarks. Sample match rates do not estimate population completeness or all categories/branches.

References are online operator/government listings, not phone calls or field visits. Presence in a directory or OSM does not verify current opening or inventory. No sample has independently surveyed entrance coordinates; node positions and way/relation bounding-box centers are distinguished.

Named candidate extraction covers the sample aliases as well as amenity/shop/tourism/office/leisure/historic objects. Unmatched means not found in this bounded extraction and manual review, not proven absent globally. Unnamed nearby features were not guessed into named businesses.

Frozen sample notes incorrectly assigned several Galleria tenant floors. These are corrected in the reference_review fields without changing sample membership, names, bounds or frozen hash. Government service-location descriptions themselves contain grouping/wing inconsistencies; exact floor remains uncertain.

A successful initial category extract omitted square/building-only landmarks. A successful alias-expanded extraction supplies the final results. An intermediate request returned HTTP 502 and another endpoint timed out; neither failure is treated as empty coverage. Raw attempts and downloads remain ignored.

The global extracted-element unnamed count includes many parking/amenity features and is not a count or percentage of missing business names. Hours availability is measured only on the reviewed sample matches; missing hours stay unknown.

Confirmed sample duplicate identities were not found in manual review. This is not a regional deduplication proof: same-brand alternatives are distinct branches, and named buildings, counters, ATMs and surrounding squares must retain their separate identities.

overture_decision.reason: The OSM audit demonstrates specific indoor/service/salon gaps, but no measured same-sample Overture improvement or duplicate/license-chain review exists. Do not add an unvalidated second catalog merely because OSM has gaps. Preserve the same35 sample for a future bounded supplement comparison; current pilot uses OSM with explicit incomplete-coverage behavior.
overture_decision.license_boundary: Official October2026 guide lists source-specific CC0-1.0, CDLA-Permissive-2.0 and Apache-2.0 records; existence confidence does not prove business hours. No Overture records are imported or redistributed in this audit.
